phrases.english: I am looking for a new job opportunity.
phrases.arabic: أنا أبحث عن فرصة عمل جديدة.
phrases.context: Use this when you are actively seeking employment.
Inquire about the typical daily schedule at a workplace.

phrases.english: This project requires a lot of effort.
phrases.arabic: هذا المشروع يتطلب الكثير من الجهد.
phrases.pronunciation: Hatha al-mashroo' yatatallab al-katheer min al-juhd.
phrases.context: Describe a task that demands significant work.

phrases.english: I need to schedule a meeting with the manager.
phrases.arabic: أحتاج إلى تحديد موعد اجتماع مع المدير.
phrases.pronunciation: AHTaaj ila taHdeed maw'id ijtimaa' ma'a al-mudeer.
phrases.context: Arrange a formal discussion with your supervisor.

phrases.english: Our company has a great team.
phrases.context: Praise the collaborative spirit of your colleagues.
